semiconductor_relevance: High — The company is a fabless semiconductor design house specializing in RISC-V networking SoC platforms.
summary: Aheesa Digital Innovations is a fabless semiconductor design company based in India, focusing on the development of indigenous RISC-V networking SoC platforms. Their flagship product, the Vihaan Networking SoC, is designed to enhance enterprise, edge, and automotive networks, reducing reliance on imported telecom silicon.
capabilities: Vihaan Networking SoC for enterprise, edge, and automotive networks

regional_presence.India: The company is based in India and develops its products domestically, supported by the MeitY Design-Linked Incentive (DLI) scheme.
